$comment: W44 G0 part 1, the mechanism-check protocol's ladders (charter clause 3; Decision Log 3; X50).
Every rung is a complete scratch candidate built by build-candidate.ts from the published c05
documents (or from a declared base rung) moved on ONE leaf, or on the second tap's share with its
2x width, drawn in candidate mode in scratch on the fixed cells below, WebGPU tier, at 2x AND at
1x. A ladder renders nothing before part 1 is hashed. What a ladder may decide is `decisions`

fixedCells.rule: three fine pitches (checkerboard-4, -8, hc-text-7), three coarse (the pitch-16 checkerboard, -32, -64) and the photo; both poses wherever a non-referee, non-holdout pair exists; thin, mid and thick spans; each rendered at 2x and as its 1x twin. No referee and no holdout cell (the planner's lists are the check).

c05.label: c05-control
c05.why: rung 0: the published c05 documents unmoved, under the scratch key token; its captures must be byte-identical to the canonical strict-mode c05 captures (the instrument's control)

floor1.label: l1-floor2x-1.0
floor1.why: families B and C hold the floor at 1 (charter Design, move 1), and at floor 1 every 2x ramp start is above the deep sharp share, so a ramp leaf clamped at c05 is live here; it is L1's top rung

ladders.unit: fraction (the deep value's heavy share at dpr 2)
ladders.why: the deferral's item; the receded document inherits it

ladders.unit: device px (heavySigmaCssFor divides by the ratio)
ladders.why: one heavy width alone, at B's floor of 1; the receded document overrides this leaf (14), so the inactive cells must not move; no rung below the chain's level-1 width (1.542 texels): the mechanism has no small values

ladders.unit: share: signed fraction; sizeHeavySecondSigma2x: CSS px (heavySecondSigmaCssFor does not divide; 3 CSS px = 6 device px at 2x)
ladders.rungOrder: share then width; the width ladder is the three rungs at share 0.5, the share ladder the three at width 3
ladders.inertSetting: sizeHeavySecondSigma 0 CSS px: at width 0 the plan declines and heavySecondEnabled is false at dpr 1; proven only if every 1x capture of every rung is byte-identical to c05-control's, otherwise C is struck (X48)
ladders.why: the second heavy tap at a middle width, at C's floor of 1; one share leaf for both scales, so the 1x width must be the setting the renderer declines at

ladders.unit: fraction (the sharp share at the contour, thin span)
ladders.why: finding (i); the receded document overrides this leaf, so the inactive cells must not move
read as a ladder, moved only if the start alone is not within; read at both bases because at c05 the 2x thick start sits below the deep sharp share and clamps
finding (iii)'s predicted lever; at c05 a start at or below the thin deep sharp share (0.40) clamps, so it is read at floor 1 too

ladders.tied: the two take one value, as they do at c05 (0.04) and at 0.5
ladders.why: at c05 0.04 sits below every mid and thick deep sharp share (0.16-0.32) and clamps to an inert term: the c05 rung records the clamp; the floor-1 rungs are the reading
the receded document's own heavy width

checks.control: c05-control's captures, 2x and 1x, against the canonical strict-mode c05 captures of the same cells: decoded pixels equal (and the PNG SHA-256s reported)
checks.x48: every rung's 1x captures pixel-identical to c05-control's 1x captures
checks.mustNotAct: every rung's captures of a mustNotAct cell pixel-identical to its base's
checks.betweenRungs: for every acting cell, whether adjacent rungs are pixel-identical, and |delta T1 web| against the cell's bar
checks.transfer: per rung and acting cell: T1 web/native, T1-deep, T1-fine and T1-lattice web/native, and the attenuation web(rung)/web(base) by the cell's pitch (cell widths 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 device px at 2x for checkerboard-4, -8, the pitch-16 family, -32, -64)

flat: a ladder is FLAT at a base when, on every acting cell, the T1 web values of all its rungs at that base (base included) lie within the cell's bar of each other; a leaf is FLAT when its ladder is flat at every base it is read at
nonFlatRange: per ladder, in rung order across all its bases: drop an end rung while it and its neighbour lie within the bar on every acting cell; what remains, [lo, hi], is the range the ladder showed not flat
decisions: strike a flat leaf (removed from part 2, its ladder cited)
strike a leaf whose ladder moves any 1x capture (X48: a family that cannot keep the 1x rows byte-identical is struck)
fix family C's inert 1x setting (sizeHeavySecondSigma 0) when L3 proves it, or strike C when it does not
narrow a grid to its ladder's non-flat range
notDecided: anything else a ladder shows (a transfer that contradicts a prediction, a better family, a pose that moves where it must not) is recorded as a finding and changes nothing in part 2 (charter Risks: the draft as written, the finding recorded)
